comment: MANUAL TAP/PAY, the rejecting side (docs/design/viewer-manual-tap-pay.md). Kitchen makes {G} or {U} and the human asked for {R}, so the line is ILLEGAL with the reason "'Kitchen' cannot produce {R} (it makes {GU})" -- it is NOT silently repaired into a legal tap. That distinction is the whole point of the fallback: an engine that quietly fixes an awkward hand-forced tap hands the allocation straight back to the allocator the human was overriding, and passes every outcome-based test while doing so. Note the line is otherwise perfectly playable (its accepting twin edf_manual_tap_dictates_the_face.json is the same board and the same cast), so the verdict here can only be the tap. Same wildcard-id and MTG_HUMAN_PLAY notes as that twin.
